owner: Dr Terence Poon and the team
summary: Thirty two years of experience and a wide laser menu are strengths, but an unfinished footer and an old closure notice appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: The footer appears to read '© Neutral Bay Laser & Dermatology Clinic year. All rights reserved.' with a template placeholder instead of the year.
findings.cost: A placeholder in the footer makes a medical practice look unattended.

findings.problem: A banner appears to say the clinic is closed until January 18th while reception reopens on January 11th, and the text repeats.
findings.cost: An old or confusing closure notice may lead patients to think you are shut.

findings.problem: The page appears to say '18 laser, light and energy-based treatment options' and also 'over 16 specialty laser and light-based therapies', and the clinic name appears three ways.
findings.cost: Conflicting numbers and names weaken trust and search visibility.
findings.fix: One number and one clinic name.

findings.problem: The main booking button is labelled Contact Us and appears to link to an external HotDoc page, Recive appears in the copy, and no testimonials appear.
findings.cost: Unclear booking and no proof lose patients.
findings.fix: Clear Book button, proofread copy and reviews.

redesign: Current footer and no stale notices.
One treatment count and clinic name.
